claimText: Ode to Joy (theme, arranged for beginners): the first two phrases of the theme in C major, melody unchanged, with our own block-chord left hand

checks.source: https://archive.org/details/VaultM1001B415Op1251826 (Beethoven, Symphony No. 9, first edition, Mainz: Schott, 1826, plate 2322; finale pp. 101 and 113)
checks.result: Transposed from D to C, the item matches the theme as the baritone sings it ("Freude, schöner Götterfunken", p. 113, repeated quarters) and the dotted figure of bars 4 and 8 as the cellos and basses first play it (bars 92-99, p. 101).

outcomeNote: Checked 2026-09-24 against the Soprano of Mutopia 528, transposed from G to C. Bars 4 and 8 had the dotted figure (E. D D, D. C C) flattened to two notes, dropping a melody note each; they now follow the source, which the Beginner caps allow, and bar 4's left hand holds the dominant chord through the half cadence. 0 differences in pitch, order, onset and duration; the source matches its MIDI. Still Beginner. Also checked by eye against the 1826 first edition (T100).
